critical_threats.threat: Mutable tag is redeployed after retargeting
Registry GC removes a signature, SBOM, or platform manifest that is weakly referenced
critical_threats.unresolved: Registry implementations differ in referrer GC semantics.

critical_threats.threat: Primary registry compromise replaces manifests or serves bytes inconsistent with digest
critical_threats.unresolved: Compromise of both project signing and custody authorities remains catastrophic.

critical_threats.threat: Replication copies manifests but omits referrers or unknown artifact types
critical_threats.unresolved: Some registry copy tools still have incomplete referrer support.

critical_threats.threat: Deletion propagates to every registry and object-store copy
critical_threats.unresolved: Object-store administrator compromise can bypass registry policy.

critical_threats.threat: Multi-platform index is retained but one architecture manifest or layer is missing
critical_threats.unresolved: Rare platform variants increase retention and validation burden.

critical_threats.threat: Scanner labels a malicious image safe
critical_threats.unresolved: Semantic maliciousness cannot be fully decided automatically.
